title: Old messages
summary: The one Bipe place that explains missing history (ADR 0073). It follows the SDK verification, recovery and backup state and, when this phone cannot read old messages, shows a quiet banner above the chat list that opens a sheet with the two ways to get them.

verificationState.description: Encryption.verificationState. unverified: this phone has no access to the history keys.

recoveryState.description: Encryption.recoveryState. Sets whether the recovery key row shows (enabled or incomplete) and whether settings shows bipe_account_recovery_key_saved.

backupState.description: Encryption.backupState. Never shown as words; only used to know when keys download.

bannerDismissed.description: The person tapped Agora não. Stays on this phone; the banner comes back after 7 days while unverified.

sheetOpen.description: The sheet with the two ways is open.

observe.effect: After sign-in: listens with verificationStateListener, recoveryStateListener and backupStateListener and updates the state.

openSheet.effect: Opens the sheet: bipe_recovery_history_note and the rows that apply.

approveWithDevice.effect: Opens device-verification as newPhone. Only when hasOtherDevices.

useRecoveryKey.effect: Opens recovery-key-enter. Only when recoveryState is enabled or incomplete.

dismiss.effect: Hides the banner and sets bannerDismissed.

notes: A new account on its first phone has nothing to verify and sees nothing (onboarding.md: no crypto words for new users). The banner shows only when verificationState is unverified and the account has history elsewhere (hasOtherDevices, or recoveryState enabled or incomplete).
With neither way, the sheet says bipe_app_history_none: old chats stay on the old phone, new messages work here (ADR 0073).
Build the client with autoEnableCrossSigning and autoEnableBackups on, so a new account gets cross-signing and key backup with no screen.
No Element crypto screens or words (parity onboarding-no-element-crypto): no reset of the identity, no 'verify this session', no key backup settings.
